ANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS SECOND AMENDMENT TO ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Amendment"), made as of the 2day of February, 2025, by and among NYT COLLEGE POINT LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address care of Wildflower Ltd.LLC,80 8thAvenue,Suite 1602,NewYork,NewYork 10011 ("WFIx"or"Developer"). STATEMENTOFFACTS A.NYT is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,located in the Borough of Queens,City and State of NewYork,County of Queens,known as Lot 100 in Block 4282 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,Queens County (the“Tax Map"), and as and by the street address 25-70 Whitestone Expressway, Queens, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (*NYT Land," and the buildings and improvements now existing on the NYT Land, collectively, the “NYT Building") (the NYT Land and the NYT Building, collectively, the “NYT Premises"). B. Developer(as successor-in-interest to NYT) is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Queens, City and State of New York, County of Queens, known as Lot 10 in Block 4282 on the Tax Map, and as and by the street address 28-10 Whitestone Expressway, Queens, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof ("Developer Land,”and, the buildings and improvements now or hereafter existing on the Developer Land, collectively,the“New Building") (the Developer Land and the New Building, collectively, the “Developer Premises"). C. NYT, as fee owner of the NYT Land and as predecessor-in-interest of Developer in the Developer Land,and WFIX,as tenant under the Interim Lease (defined below), entered into that certain Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement, dated as of April 11, 2022 and recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York (Queens County) Amendment to Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement, dated as of March 26, 2024, and recorded in the Register's Office under CRFN 2024000082290 (as amended, the “Existing ZLDA"). D. WFIX has installed a circuit on the New Building (the“Circuit") that causes thelights currently mounted on the exterior of theNewBuilding that illuminate the part of the shared roadway highlighted on Exhibit C attached hereto and made part hereof (the “Shared Road Lights")toremainonbetweendusk and dawn each nightfor thebenefit of each of Developer and NyT. E. The parties hereto wish to further amend the Existing ZLDA, as set forth herein. 4937-6834-07589
